text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the day of the autumn Tenno Sho arrives.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Good luck out there today, Opera O! You too, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: You too, Digital!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even the normally reserved Meisho Doto is in high spirits for today's momentous race.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha! Well met, Digital! Welcome to my coronation.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I acknowledge your efforts. You've made astonishing leaps of progress, and now, here you are, right on our tails.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But you know as well as I that your skills are still lacking!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I am the Centurial Overlord! And over a medium-distance track of turf, my power is absolute!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right, Digital?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes… You're… absolutely correct.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For a moment, she appears on the brink of admitting defeat. However…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You are indeed the Overlord… I have to acknowledge our difference in skill if I'm going to cause an upset.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And now, having acknowledged it, I will find a way… a means to catch up…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. No amount of thinking will save you. You have already crossed the Rubicon.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha! What could possibly happen to offer you the advantage now?! What scheme can you produce?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Plip, plop…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What… strate—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Psssshhhh!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah! Is this… rain?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Rain?! Heaven weeps…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A sudden bout of rain hits. While not exactly a storm, it may affect the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the ground becomes more damp…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: This rain… Does it symbolize the crying of my beloved Umas?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: No… These must be tears of joy, celebrating my triumph.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I am the All-Rounder. There's no path that I've shied away from on my journey to this stage.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And in this final moment, the entrance to the narrow path only I can run has shown its face! The heavens have finally smiled upon me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho on… soft turf… Hmmm…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: After all the roads I've run to get here, poor turf is like a walk in the park! Plus, I'm quite at home in the water after all my time spent in the ocean of Uma simping!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: With this turn of events, I'm bound to win! Shower me in your love, o gods!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fshaaaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It begins to pour. The sky's gone completely dark, save for a beam of light shining down on Agnes Digital.
